title: Complementary Vulnerabilities: Auditing and Governing Clinician-LLM Error Overlap
description: But a second reasoner reduces error only insofar as it fails differently from the first. We say that a clinician and a model have complementary vulnerabilities to the extent that they break down through different mechanisms and on different cases. We therefore propose a predeployment audit in which each site measures error overlap on its own cases.

paper.title: Complementary Vulnerabilities: Auditing and Governing Clinician-LLM Error Overlap
paper.authors: Mohsen Amoei, Kathleen Fraser, Dan Poenaru

example_outputs.title: Default inputs
example_outputs.summary: On 36 MedQA cases, wrong AI suggestions cut the proxy clinician's accuracy from 70% to 50%. Double-fault rate 3%, Yule's Q +0.30. Both readers are LLMs: Claude Haiku stands in for the clinician and Claude Sonnet is the model under audit. 36 exam questions, far below the roughly 1,000 adjudicated cases the paper recommends.

inputs.label: Clinician proxy
inputs.description: Reader standing in for the unaided clinician: small-fast (Claude Haiku, answers from first impression), small (Haiku, careful) or large (Claude Sonnet)

inputs.label: Model under audit
inputs.description: The candidate model: large (Sonnet), small (Haiku, careful) or small-fast

inputs.label: Case mix
inputs.description: mixed (equal thirds), diagnosis, management, or mechanism/other (question type parsed from the stem)

inputs.label: Assisted workflow
inputs.description: both, model_conforms (model sees the clinician's impression first), clinician_defers (clinician sees the AI suggestion first), or off

inputs.label: Anchor source
inputs.description: What the second reader is shown: clinician (the other reader's real answers), enriched (real answers plus a wrong one planted on a third of the cases it got right, so enough wrong anchors exist) or always_wrong

inputs.label: Your paired counts
inputs.description: Skip the LLMs and audit your own paired record: shared_success,model_only_error,clinician_only_error,shared_error, optionally

inputs.label: Simulator accuracy
inputs.description: Accuracy of the three hypothetical models in the no-LLM simulator panel

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.description: Which cases are drawn and which anchors are planted
